candidate_evaluation.candidate_order: the exact order declared in each family specification
candidate_evaluation.failed_candidate: record failure and stop the affected experiment; do not silently replace its configuration or inspect test data

hierarchy: training-weighted validation log loss, lower is better
simpler model or architecture if still tied
classification.threshold_selection: no optimization; threshold is frozen before training and test authorization
classification.tie_breaker_definition: RF candidates use rf_simplicity_key ascending; TGNN candidates use lower hidden dimension, fewer layers, lower dropout, then earlier candidate index.

hierarchy: simpler model or architecture if still tied
regression.tie_breaker_definition: RF candidates use rf_simplicity_key ascending; TGNN candidates use the TGNN simplicity order; then earlier candidate index.

rf_simplicity_order.purpose: Final tie-break only; validation and test performance never redefine simplicity.
rf_simplicity_order.max_features_rationale: sqrt evaluates fewer candidate predictors at each split than 0.75 for the fixed 12-predictor RF schema.
rf_simplicity_order.ordering: Compare the tuple lexicographically in ascending order; the first unequal element decides.

component_definitions.n_estimators: The candidate's explicit integer n_estimators; lower is simpler.
component_definitions.max_depth_is_none: 0 when max_depth is a finite integer, 1 when max_depth is None; finite depths therefore precede unbounded depth.
component_definitions.max_depth_value_if_not_none_else_0: The finite max_depth integer when present, otherwise 0; among finite depths, lower is simpler.
component_definitions.min_samples_leaf: Use the negative explicit integer; larger min_samples_leaf is simpler.
component_definitions.max_features_simplicity_rank: 0 for the literal string sqrt and 1 for numeric 0.75; sqrt is simpler.
component_definitions.candidate_index: The zero-based declared candidate index; lower is the deterministic final tie-break.

rf_simplicity_order.none_ranking: max_depth=None is explicitly the most complex max_depth choice and is encoded after every finite max_depth. max_leaf_nodes, max_samples, and monotonic_cst are explicit None values identical in every RF candidate and therefore add no comparison dimension; no undocumented None judgment is permitted.
rf_simplicity_order.performance_independence: This key is computed only from the frozen candidate configuration and candidate index, never from validation or test performance.

final_identity_freeze.freeze_event: After the four independent model-specific training gates accept their outputs and before any test target is opened.
final_identity_freeze.after_test_opening: No retuning, recalibration, feature change, architecture change, seed change, or model replacement.

selection_outputs: For each task, retain a complete candidate table with candidate index, configuration, seed, train/validation sizes, primary and secondary metrics, tie-break decisions, and immutable selected identity.
